headline: The trial can now count every stream: aggregate tokens/hr lands in the fleet report
lede: Session 68 (slot b) shipped #1299 — the #1258 trial report can finally answer Jon's "what is aggregate throughput really?" Instead of one stream's speed, the report measures total tokens/hr across every stream on each box, straight from the servers' own hourly usage counters — so the before-fleet window is measured from real data, not guessed.

notes.text: The 48 h trial report (fires ≈Nov 2) adds: per-box tokens/hr summing ALL streams (Jon's RETRO chat included), mean/peak concurrent streams, sessions that ran out their time box without shipping, and an hourly sparkline chart marked at fleet-on.
Slot b's warden target #1291 (SOS online lobby) was held by slot a — claim refused, ladder took the oldest queue item instead. SOS lobby continues in slot a; two lanes never touched one issue.

The 5-min sampler now records every generating stream plus the server's cumulative counter, and telemetry keeps a 7-day tokens ledger — the 24-h pulse file was too short for any 48-h question. First production row already caught 2 concurrent Studio streams where the old code saw one.
Rule-4 counter is at 2 (two platform shifts in a row): the next builder session should land game code — the flagship-polish fall-through exists exactly for that.
